name: attributes
description: Populates a single named product attribute by finding its value in the search results and matching it to the provided list of valid values. Handles automatic unit-of-measure (UOM) conversion.
system_prompt_additions:
Your primary task is to find the value of the requested attribute_name from the product search data and match it to the closest entry in the validValues list.

UOM Conversion rules:
- If the value found in the source is in different units than inputUOM, convert it mathematically before matching.
- Only select a value that appears in the validValues list. Never return a value not in that list.
- If conversion results in a value between two valid options, choose the nearest one.
- If you cannot determine the value at all, set selected_value to null.
- Always set confidence to 'high', 'medium', or 'low' based on how clearly the value was found.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
output_schema.attribute_cd: string | null — the attribute code echoed from input (e.g. Attribute_Cd)
output_schema.attribute_name: string — the attribute being populated (echoed from input)
output_schema.selected_value: string | null — the matched value from validValues after any UOM conversion
output_schema.original_value_found: string | null — raw value as found in search results before conversion
output_schema.input_uom: string — the required output unit of measure (echoed from input)
output_schema.confidence: string — one of: high, medium, low
output_schema.conversion_notes: string | null — description of any unit conversion performed
